title: Returns and Refunds Policy
brief: Explains the 30-day return window from delivery for unused items, 14 days for opened electronics, the 6 dollar return label fee that is waived for defects, and that refunds arrive in 5 business days to the original payment method. Also says refunds need an approval from the support team.

title: Warranty Policy
brief: Covers the 2 year warranty on tents and packs and the lifetime warranty on Emberhollow cast iron, what is and is not covered, and how to start a claim. States that the return label fee is waived for defects.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
brief: Orders can be cancelled only while status is processing, and need an approval from support. Shipped orders are handled as returns. Refunds go to the original payment method in 5 business days.

title: Shipping Policy
brief: Standard shipping takes 3 to 6 business days, express takes 1 to 2. Standard is free on orders over 75 dollars. Names the carriers Marlowe Freight and Brindle Parcel and explains tracking ids.

title: Catalog Sheet: Quillridge 3-Person Tent
brief: Specs for the Quillridge 3-person tent: 3.4 kg packed weight, 2 doors, 3-season, 3000 mm fly rating, price 289.00 dollars. Mentions the 2 year warranty.

title: Catalog Sheet: Fernpath 45L Backpack
brief: Specs for the Fernpath 45L pack: 1.3 kg, rain cover included, adjustable torso 43 to 53 cm, price 129.00 dollars. Mentions the 55L alternative at 149.00 dollars.

title: Catalog Sheet: Emberhollow 5-Piece Cookware Set
brief: Specs for the Emberhollow cast iron set: skillet, two pots, lid and griddle, 6.8 kg total, price 164.00 dollars. Lifetime warranty on the cast iron and seasoning care.

title: Catalog Sheet: Mothdown 0C Sleeping Bag
brief: Specs for the Mothdown bag: 0C comfort limit, 950 g, recycled fill, regular length 190 cm, price 96.00 dollars. Packing and care notes.

title: Catalog Sheet: Fernglow Lantern
brief: Specs for the Fernglow lantern: 300 lumens, 40 hours on low, rechargeable with a 3 hour charge, price 42.50 dollars. Opened electronics return rule of 14 days.

title: Size and Fit Guide
brief: How to choose a pack torso length from 43 to 53 cm, a sleeping bag length (regular 190 cm, long 205 cm) and a tent size by number of people. Includes a simple measuring tip.

title: Gift Card Policy
brief: Gift cards come in 25, 50 and 100 dollar amounts, never expire, cannot be refunded to cash, and cannot be used to buy other gift cards. Lost cards can be replaced with proof of purchase.

title: Price Adjustment Policy
brief: If the price of an item drops within 7 days of purchase, the difference is credited to the original payment method on request. Excludes clearance and bundles.

title: Customer FAQ
brief: Short answers about support hours (Monday to Saturday, 8:00 to 20:00 Eastern), order status, address changes before shipping, free shipping over 75 dollars, and where to find tracking ids.

title: Care and Repair Guide
brief: How to clean and dry a tent, re-season Emberhollow cast iron, and charge a lantern safely. Explains when to start a warranty claim instead of repairing.
